summary_1line: Arjuna praises Krishna’s cosmic form, asks forgiveness and to see his gentle form again; Krishna teaches that devoted, selfless love is the sure path to reach him.
themes: awe and fear of the divine

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna, trembling with folded hands, bows before the blazing universal form of Krishna that fills the cosmos with countless arms and faces.
Krishna withdraws the terrifying cosmic form and stands again in a calm four‑armed form with crown, mace, and discus, reassuring Arjuna.
Arjuna prostrates fully on the battlefield, begging forgiveness from Krishna for having once addressed him casually as a friend.
